criteria.text: With the /global/event stream down, a bypassPermissions session completes real read, edit, and external_directory tool calls without pending permission asks.
criteria.reason: The existing live test did not take /global/event down and did not exercise external_directory. Bash is intentionally excluded because #878 now requires its SSE ask.

criteria.text: Engine-side GET /permission shows no pending asks accumulating for a bypass session.
criteria.reason: The final 1/1 live run asserted an empty engine permission queue after controlled real read, bash, and edit calls.

criteria.text: external_directory is explicitly covered and tested, not just bash/edit tools.
criteria.reason: The fork evaluation test asserts external_directory resolves to allow while bash resolves to ask.

criteria.text: Regression test asserting bypass does not depend on _listenGlobal being reachable — the existing #1392 contract tests all assume a live stream and would not have caught this.
criteria.reason: No current test makes the bridge unreachable; creation-payload inspection is not bridge-unreachability evidence.
